title: Data Engineer GCP
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are Seeking a "Data Engineer" to build, optimize, and maintain the modern data platform within a cloud environment.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Work experience on relational l & non-relational databases platform
  • Design, build, and maintain robust and scalable data pipelines for batch and real-time processing, from ingestion to final consumption.
  • Construct and manage the data lake infrastructure (multi-cloud), ensuring governance, security, and scalability.
  • Administer and optimize various database management systems (DBMS) , including relational and NoSQL databases.
  • Implement real-time data stream processing solutions using technologies like Apache Kafka or similar.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and translate them into robust technical solutions.
  • Ensure data quality, observability, and reliability through testing, monitoring, and pipeline versioning.
  • Implement and enforce data security and privacy policies.
  • Automate repetitive data engineering and management tasks, applying DevOps and CI/CD principles.
  • Proven experience in data engineering, focusing on both batch and streaming pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience with modern data platforms and orchestration tools (e.g., Apache Spark, Airflow, Databricks).
  • Deep knowledge of GCP cloud environments and data-related services.
  • Proficiency in SQL and experience with both relational and non-relational databases.
  • Experience with data streaming technologies such as Apache Kafka or managed cloud services.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, Scala, or Java.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible) is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.



What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?

Health insurance

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Assistente de Folha de Pagamento (DP)
description:
Descrição da Empresa

A ContabilizaEcom é uma empresa de contabilidade especialmente voltada para o e‑commerce, que combina expertise fiscal, tributária e empresarial para apoiar lojas online no Brasil.

Alguns destaques da empresa:

  • Foi criada por quem “nasceu em um e‑commerce”, ou seja, compreende os desafios práticos desse tipo de negócio.
  • Oferece serviços como abertura de empresa, análise fiscal de produtos, configuração de ERP e canais de venda, recuperação de impostos pagos indevidamente, planejamento tributário e busca de benefícios fiscais.
  • Foca em economia de impostos, segurança jurídica e regularização fiscal dos seus clientes.
  • Tem métricas que demonstram credibilidade: mais de 300 sellers ativos, cerca de 96% de satisfação dos clientes e mais de R$ 10 milhões em impostos economizados.


Sobre a Vaga:

Estamos procurando um Assistente de Folha de Pagamento (DP) para se juntar à equipe da ContabilizaEcom em Curitiba. Este cargo envolve a execução de tarefas diárias relacionadas a folha de pagamento no setor de departamento pessoal que busque a garantia de conformidade com as leis trabalhistas e legais vigentes.


Este é um cargo de tempo integral presencial, permitindo algumas atividades administrativas realizadas remotamente, onde o colaborador tem espaço para o crescimento em um ambiente descontraído com limites e responsabilidades.


Qualificações acadêmicas esperadas e atribuições da função


  • Formação: Graduação cursando ou completa em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, RH ou áreas correlatas.
  • Processamento da Folha: Executar o cálculo mensal da folha de pagamento, garantindo a exatidão de salários, descontos e proventos.
  • Cálculo de Encargos: Calcular e conferir o INSS, FGTS e IRRF.
  • Fechamento e Conferência: Realizar o fechamento da folha e emitir os relatórios de conferência (holerites), assegurando a conformidade legal.
  • Emissão de Guias: Gerar e enviar as guias de recolhimento dos encargos sociais e impostos (Ex: DAF, GPS/DARF Previdenciário).
  • Rotinas de Pessoal: executar cálculo e registro de férias e processamento de rescisões contratuais, com o devido registro no sistema.
  • Obrigações Acessórias: Realizar o lançamento e acompanhamento dos eventos mensais e periódicos no eSocial, garantindo a qualidade e o envio das informações.
  • Atendimento: Prestar suporte e esclarecimento de dúvidas aos colaboradores sobre holerites, benefícios e questões trabalhistas básicas.


Competências Comportamentais


  • Organização.
  • Habilidades de análise.
  • Proatividade.


Remuneração:

  • Salário a combinar (enviar pretensão salarial no currículo)
  • Vale transporte


Benefícios:

  • Vale alimentação
  • Vale transporte
  • Plano de saúde
  • Plano odontológico
  • Plano de carreira
  • Auxílio faculdade

title: Business Intelligence Partner
description:
Business Intelligence Partner

Location: Sao Paulo Brazil


about Randstad Enterprise

Randstad Sourceright is a global talent leader, providing solutions and expertise that help companies position for growth, execute on strategy, and improve business agility. Our experience encompasses all facets of the talent acquisition of permanent employees and the contingent and contractor workforce. Key offerings include Managed Services Provider (MSP) programs, Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO), and Blended Workforce Solutions. Randstad Sourceright offers solutions Globally in North America, EMEA, and APAC. Working for a multi-country organization means working with clients and colleagues from different backgrounds. This results in a digital way of working and requires a proactive and culturally inclusive mindset.


job context

and purpose


Purpose of the job

This role aims to partner with the Regional and global BI customers within RSR (who can include but are not limited to Data engineering, BI Support Teams, Operational Teams, Internal teams, and RSR clients) and provide business solutions through data.

This position has operational and technical responsibility for reporting, analytics, and visualization dashboards across all operating companies within RSR. This position will develop processes and strategies to consolidate, automate, and improve reporting and dashboards for external clients and internal stakeholders.

As a Business Intelligence Partner, you will oversee the end-to-end delivery of regional and global account and client BI reporting. This will include working with data engineering to provide usable datasets, creating dashboards with meaningful insights & visualizations within our BI solution, and ongoing communication and partnering with the ‘BI consumers. Must be knowledgeable in Tableau and SQL. The key to this is that as a Business Intelligence Partner, you will be a commercial and operational expert who can translate data into insights. You will use this to mitigate risk, find operational and revenue-generating opportunities, and provide business solutions.


Key stakeholders

  • RSR internal stakeholders include but are not limited to C-Suite, Finance, Regional Managing Directors, Vice Presidents, and operational account leaders.
  • RSR external clients


Position Summary

Development of BI solutions (50%):

  • Responsible for delivering BI solutions for the program
  • Responsible for ensuring all contractual conditions around reporting, financial elements, SLA's, and KPI's are reviewed, understood, and adhered to
  • Assess operating reality to validate solution requirements and adjust as needed.
  • Implement and reinforce tools, including standards, procedures, and documentation.
  • Ensure the team has living documentation on reporting requirements, data processes, and other program-specific content.
  • Oversee the design and build of insightful, scalable, and actionable visualizations.
  • Develop, document, and maintain a comprehensive quality management program
  • Build, implement, and schedule production standards of files and reports to ensure accuracy and timeliness.
  • Ensure reporting quality and accuracy by evaluating, integrating, and complementing data sources.
  • Execute continuous process improvement process.
  • Knowledge of general database functions, data storage, data models, SQL, and data transfer protocols

Consult (30%):

  • Responsible for being the liaison between the external client, operations teams and the wider BI teams
  • Using client data and insights to highlight and provide observations, provide recommendations, and contribute to ongoing business discussions and decision-making.
  • Analyze the client’s data to present the account leadership and client with potential approaches or opportunities for improving service delivery performance and elevating value-added opportunities.
  • Have commercial awareness and work with the account leadership to maximize revenue-generating opportunities.
  • Solicit feedback from internal and external stakeholders in an organized manner to contribute to the objectives of the BI team and demonstrate RSR value.
  • Contribute to the success of a wider global team.
  • Qualify the business needs of each request and use expertise to partner on solutions.
  • Develop strong working relationships with the client stakeholders and account leads.
  • Serve as a functional and technical data visualization and business intelligence subject matter expert.

Maintain Standards (20%):

  • Work within the agreed parameters aligned to the global method of BI production
  • Leverage an agile work environment to incorporate new innovative and value components into existing portfolios
  • Organize a feedback standard from stakeholders (internal and external) in order to create use case, case study materials and other customer-facing material
  • Promote available resources and enterprise tools for operations training/ coaching needs from a BI perspective.
  • Ensure data governance principles and guidelines are being met


job

Requirements

Please share your resume in English .

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree a plus

Mandatory Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in a similar role
  • Project Management and/or process improvement experience
  • MI/Business Intelligence/Data Science/Analytics background
  • Proficient with an ANSI-compliant SQL dialect
  • Proven experience with Tableau dashboard development
  • Ability to turn ambiguous information and unstructured challenges into substantive insights.

Preferred Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in a similar role
  • Industry exposure to business process outsourcing and/or workforce planning (e.g., MSP/RPO)

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills required for various levels throughout external and internal organizations
  • Excellent presentation skills used in delivering solutions to executive-level clients
  • Demonstrated continuous improvement, process documentation, and workflow skills
  • Excellent working knowledge of MS - Excel with knowledge of macros and pivot tables.
  • Excellent working knowledge of Google products, and visualization tools Tableau, etc.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects, tasks, and meet deadlines while maintaining quality
  • Ability to synthesize and analyze information and ideas
  • Strong drive and commitment to delivering outstanding results
  • Have the ability to provide value with the use of analytics to help achieve the account’s objectives and the client’s initiatives.
  • Ability to create meaningful insights and metrics that aligned to business priorities and objectives
  • Data visualization preferred; ability to interpret data and translate it to non-tech people.
  • Proven experience with Tableau dashboard development
  • Ability to write Intermediate SQL scripts
  • Experience in data pipeline creation, quality improvement and analysis to provide teams with actionable insights, informing strategy, impact and investments.
  • Experience with analytics tools.
  • Extensive experience in technical client service (i.e. consulting experience).
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills with attention to detail and a well-organized, structured approach to work.
  • Must be fluent in English.


This position will require a live SQL Assessment.

Aqui você tem oportunidades sob medida para umas verdadeiras evoluções na sua carreira.


Na EQI, sabemos que seus sonhos são únicos, reconhecemos suas conquistas e oferecemos estrutura real para você ir além.


Candidate-se agora e transforme seu futuro.

title: Junior Registration Analyst
description:
Syndigo powers the continual flow of data and content throughout the entire commerce ecosystem— accelerating delivery of accurate and compelling information that increases sales on every shelf. We are the recognized leader in software and services for the management of master data, product information, digital assets, and content syndication and analytics across industries including grocery, foodservice, hardlines, home improvement, oil & gas, pet, health and beauty, automotive, apparel, and healthcare products.

Syndigo serves the industry’s largest two-sided network, connecting more than 50,000 global users across 12,000+ global brands with more than 1,750 global retailers.

Basically, we're the people that deliver the rich, accurate product content that helps consumers shop online with confidence, and helps brands and retailers operate efficient product supply chains. We cannot do all of this without our amazing employees who make the magic happen here at Syndigo. As we continue to grow, we’re always looking to identify talented individuals to join our team.

***Candidate Must Be Located in Joinville, Santa Catarina***

As a Junior Registration Analyst at  Syndigo ,  you’ll  play a key role in ensuring product information is  accurate , complete, and ready for approval. This position is perfect for detail-oriented individuals who enjoy working with data and supporting quality processes.

HOW WE’LL BE WINNING TOGETHER DAY TO DAY

  • Review and interpret product packaging information and enter it into our technology platform
  • Ensure all data follows predefined guidelines and models
  • Audit content created by team members and third-party contributors for accuracy
  • Validate and correct information before manufacturer approval
  • Communicate with customers to provide guidance and request approval of  finalized content

WE SHOULD TALK IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU 

  • Completed secondary education  required ; higher education (in progress or completed) is a plus
  • Technical Skills: Comfortable with Windows systems and Microsoft Office tools
  • Soft Skills: Strong attention to detail, ability to follow structured processes, and clear communication skills
  • Experience:  No prior experience  required — we’ll  provide training!
  • Ability to work in-person at our Joinville office, 5 days a week.
Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

To achieve the best version of our organization, we know it takes new ideas, new approaches, new perspectives and new ways of thinking. A purpose we are 100% committed to cultivating.

Diversity is woven into our fabric at Syndigo and it’s how we stay an industry leader, innovating technology solutions that equip our customers with everything they need to be successful! 

All are welcome here and we invite you to join our team if you are ready to help us continue that growth! 

GDPR/CCPA

Syndigo, to process applications, holds onto data for a "reasonable time" after applications are submitted. This data is stored for Syndigo's internal use by HR/Recruiting Staff only. Verified requests for data deletion and exports will be completed upon request.

Syndigo Job Applicant Privacy Notice

At Syndigo, we care about your privacy. As you go through our recruitment process, we are committed to being transparent about how we process your personal data. To learn more about how Syndigo processes your personal data, go to our Job Applicant Privacy Notice .

title: Coordenador fiscal - Torre de faturamento
description:
Briefing da posição:


Como Coordenador/Supervisor Fiscal da Torre de Faturamento, o profissional será responsável por liderar a operação fiscal vinculada ao faturamento da empresa (“torre” de faturamento), assegurando o correto processamento de notas fiscais, apuração de tributos diretos e indiretos, cumprimento de obrigações acessórias, e a entrega de resultados por meio de KPIs.


Espera-se perfil de liderança, domínio técnico e capacidade de interface executiva (internamente com Financeiro, Faturamento, Contabilidade, Comercial, e externamente com clientes). O inglês avançado será requisito para interação com equipes globais ou clientes internacionais.


Principais responsabilidades:


  • Coordenar as atividades da torre de faturamento: emissão e conferência de notas fiscais (saídas/entradas), conferência de faturamento, retenções, XML, NFS-e/NF-e, CTe, etc.
  • Garantir o cumprimento de obrigações acessórias: SPED Fiscal, SPED Contribuições, DCTF, EFD-Contribuições, REINF, ECF/ECD, etc;
  • Implantar e monitorar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) da operação fiscal/faturamento (por exemplo: % de notas com erro fiscal, tempo de processamento, custo por nota, índice de credits fiscais aproveitados, SLA de faturamento, conformidade) e reportar à liderança executiva;
  • Desenvolver e liderar a equipe da torre (coordenados e analistas), promovendo treinamento, engajamento, definição de metas, monitoramento de performance e melhorias contínuas de processo;
  • Interface com Financeiro, Contabilidade, Comercial/Vendas, TI/ERP e auditoria, assegurando que as operações de faturamento estejam alinhadas aos controles internos, aos requisitos de compliance e às estratégias de negócio;
  • Liderar ou participar de iniciativas de melhoria de processos, automação, mapeamento de riscos fiscais, aproveitamento de créditos, e adaptação a mudanças da legislação (como reforma tributária, por exemplo) ou cenários de negócio;
  • Apresentar análises gerenciais e relatórios executivos (em inglês, quando for o caso) à alta direção ou matriz, com propostas de ação, acompanhamento de metas e suportes decisórios.


Qualificações & requisitos:


  • Formação superior em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas. Preferencialmente com registro CRC ativo (quando aplicável);
  • Experiência sólida em operação fiscal/tributária, com apuração de tributos diretos e indiretos em ambiente corporativo;
  • Experiência comprovada em faturamento ou faturamento tributário (emissão de notas fiscais, retenções, faturamento em operação com produtos/serviços) e liderança de equipe;
  • Inglês avançado (oral e escrito) – para reportes, interface com clientes estrangeiros;
  • Perfil forte de liderança, com habilidades executivas — comunicação clara, capacidade de influenciar, visibilidade junto à diretoria, visão de negócio;
  • Familiaridade com KPIs, dashboards, relatórios gerenciais, e métricas de performance da área fiscal/faturamento;
  • Atuação em ambiente de alta demanda, com foco em prazos, entregas, auditorias e mudanças regulatórias;


Competências comportamentais:


  • Visão estratégica com mindset operacional (“hands-on”);
  • Alta capacidade analítica e atenção a detalhes;
  • Orientação para resultados e melhoria contínua;
  • Excelente comunicação (com a equipe, stakeholders e diretoria);
  • Adaptabilidade e proatividade para lidar com mudanças rápidas (ex: reforma tributária, nova legislação);
  • Integridade, postura ética e foco em compliance;


Se você é um líder fiscal com visão estratégica, domínio técnico e capacidade de transformar operações através de performance, governança e indicadores, esta posição pode ser a oportunidade ideal para direcionar resultados com impacto direto no negócio.

A THE OG é uma marca nacional de lifestyle que conecta autenticidade, estética e qualidade em tudo o que faz. Atuamos nos segmentos de produtos para headshops, streetwear e eventos, entregando mais do que produtos: vendemos originalidade e conexão real com o público.

title: Junior Java Developer
description:
Apgar is looking to recruit a rising start in Java Development who wants to join our growing team in Porto Alegre, in Brazil and be part of a group of +200 teammates who are passionate about data.


What we offer you:

By joining us you will…

· Be joining a global team considered by industry specialists (e.g. Gartner) as one of the World Top20 best companies in the field of Data Management

· Have opportunity to have a practical and intense initial training supported by experienced developers that will support your integration

· Be part of a project team with experienced developers that will guide and support you

· Participate in Java Software development of state-of-the-art Data Platforms

· Implementing data management solutions for world leading international companies.


Some of the advantages of working with us..

· Flexible working schedule and ability to work in a hybrid mode (5 times in the office per month; 6 weeks a year fully remote from wherever you agree on)

· Competitive salary with benefits

· Be supported by a senior consultant (mentor) that will help in your career development

· A team spirit that will make you feel at home

· Be part of a team located in 3 different continents where diversity is as common as the air your breath


You are...

  • Mandatory soft skills : Dynamic and full of enthusiasm to know more and deliver better , who enjoys working in a team and is comfortable communicating with team mates and feels at ease on seeking for help.
  • Mandatory Knowledge : perfectly fluent in English
  • Mandatory experience : Recent graduate or up to 1 year of experience in Java-based development
  • Highly Preferable : experience at working with Agile
  • Highly Preferable : You have knowledge in environments/frameworks/tools such as (or similar to) Eclipse; IntelliJ, Hibernate, Spring; Maven
  • Preferable : You understand the concepts around Databases



Who we are…

Apgar is a leading company in the development and implementation of data platforms, recognized by analysts as one of the world leaders in this area.

We support our clients in their digital transformation, through the global team that has more than 200 consultants in our offices located in Europe (Portugal, UK, France, Switzerland, Cyprus), The Americas (USA and Brazil), Middle East (Lebanon) and South Asia and Oceania (Singapore and Australia).

Our consultants work on developing Master Data Management, Data Governance, Data Integration, Advanced Data Analytics and Machine Learning solutions among others.

Let's talk about your future in the world of data management software?

O termo Conforme + Dominante vem do teste comportamental DISC , que classifica o comportamento das pessoas em quatro perfis principais:

  • D – Dominância
  • I – Influência
  • S – Estabilidade
  • C – Conformidade

No caso, “Conforme + Dominante ” significa que a pessoa tem predominância nas características de Conformidade (C) , mas também apresenta traços de Dominância (D) .

Isso gera um perfil que normalmente é:

Conforme (C) – Característica principal

  • Extremamente organizada
  • Segue processos e padrões
  • Atenta a detalhes
  • Gosta de fazer certo da primeira vez
  • Preocupada com qualidade e precisão

Dominante (D) – Característica secundária

  • Decidida e assertiva
  • Focada em resultados
  • Não tem medo de assumir responsabilidades
  • Capaz de tomar decisões rápidas
  • Sabe cobrar e manter prazos

Essa pessoa será responsável por promover a cultura de melhoria contínua nas operações, garantindo a padronização dos processos conforme os padrões globais.

Entre suas principais atividades estão o suporte ao planejamento e execução de treinamentos Belt (Lean Six Sigma), a identificação e lançamento de projetos de melhoria de diferentes níveis de complexidade, e o acompanhamento da governança dos projetos entre as plantas. Também será responsável por desenvolver processos de gestão e garantir que o AMPS esteja integrado à rotina operacional das fábricas, assegurando consistência e entrega de resultados.

  3. Apoiar a coordenação corporativa do programa AMPS, por meio do acompanhamento da execução da implementação e governança dos Use Cases, com o objetivo de garantir o padrão de ferramentas e abordagens entre as plantas, aderência ao padrão global e entrega de resultados para a organização.
  4. Desenvolver e atuar em processos de governança e acompanhamento na gestão de ferramentas e processos do programa AMPS de forma a acompanhar sua implementação, incorporação da gestão de rotina das fábricas bem com aderência aos padrões.

  • Superior Completo, preferencialmente em Engenharia.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em:
  • Lean Manufacturing e Seis Sigma.
  • Gestão de Rotina.
  • Hoshin Kanri.
  • Metodologias de análise de falhas (A3/8D).
  • Gestão de projetos.

  • Inglês avançado.

title: Finance Manager (Brazil)
description:
The Finance Manager will oversee all financial, accounting, and tax functions for the Brazilian entity, ensuring compliance with local statutory requirements, tax regulations, and corporate reporting standards. The role encompasses daily accounting operations, month-end and year-end closings, and statutory audits, while providing management with financial analysis, budgeting support, and strategic guidance. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical accounting expertise, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to excel in a fast-paced start-up environment.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for the maintenance of accurate financial reports and accounting records in line with corporate guidelines, corporate timelines and local statutory requirements.
  • Manage the full spectrum of the accounting functions, including accounts payables, accounts receivables, balance sheet schedules, general ledger maintenance, and cash flow management.
  • Manage closing processes and preparation of accurate and timely financial reports and analysis of financial information.
  • Ensure compliance with all federal, state, and municipal tax obligations.
  • Manage tax incentives including PPB (Processo Produtivo Básico) and tax optimization opportunities ensuring compliance with Brazilian tax laws.
  • Coordinate and liaise with external parties (e.g. banks, external auditors, tax agents, corporate secretarial agents, local tax and government authorities) to ensure smooth operations.
  • Collaborate across departments in preparing and managing the OPEX budgets.
  • Identify and implement process improvements in internal accounting and financial operations efficiency.
  • Partner with business units to provide finance-related advice.
  • Coordinate with headquarters to align local reporting with group consolidation requirements.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in finance and tax management, including 3+ years in an international setting.
  • Knowledge of Direct and Indirect tax.
  • Advanced analytical skills and high attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to work independently, manage pressure, and meet tight deadlines.
  • Proficiency in English.
  • Prior experience in accounting firms is an added advantage.

title: Programa de Formação de Novos Assessores
description:
Programa de Formação de Novos Assessores | EQI Investimentos


Você sonha em construir uma carreira sólida no mercado financeiro, transformar a vida das pessoas por meio dos investimentos e ter a chance de ser contratado pela empresa que mais cresce no mercado financeiro?

Aqui na EQI estamos com vagas abertas para o Programa de Formação de Novos Assessores.

Nosso programa é uma porta de entrada para quem busca não só uma certificação, mas também uma trilha de desenvolvimento estruturada para atuar como Assessor de Investimentos com alto desempenho.


O que é o Programa?


Certificação CPA-20


Fornecemos gratuitamente todo o material, suporte técnico e auxílio especializado para que você seja aprovado na certificação CPA-20, da ANBIMA — um dos requisitos para atuar como assessor.


O que você precisa ter:


  • Ensino superior completo ou cursando (preferência para cursos em áreas como Administração, Economia, Contabilidade, Engenharias ou afins);
  • Interesse real em construir carreira no mercado financeiro;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar de forma 100% presencial em Maceió;
  • Perfil proativo, comunicativo e com vontade de aprender;
  • Disponibilidade para dedicação durante o programa.


O que oferecemos:


  • Curso completo e gratuito preparatório para CPA-20;
  • Suporte e auxílio de especialistas durante todo o processo;
  • Possibilidade real de contratação como assessor ao final do programa;
  • Ambiente de muito aprendizado, networking e crescimento.


Como participar?


Se você está comprometido com sua evolução profissional e quer começar a trilhar um caminho de sucesso no mercado financeiro, inscreva-se agora !

title: Desenvolvimento .Net Python AWS Sênior - 123226
description:
Sobre a vaga


Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 10.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo 3.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

O que estamos buscando?


Desenvolvimento Salesforce Sênior


Requisitos:

  • Experiência com .NET Core e Python. Conhecimento aprofundado em AWS (DataMesh, Lambda, RDS MySQL, DynamoDB, ECS Fargate, API Gateway, etc.). Experiência com arquitetura de microserviços e aplicações distribuídas. Conhecimento em SQL Server, MySQL e DynamoDB. Experiência com mensageria (Kafka). Prática com Docker e Kubernetes. Vivência com CI/CD (CodeCommit, CodePipeline, CodeBuild). Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e DevOps. Diferenciais: Experiência com Angular Microfront-End. Conhecimento em monitoramento e observabilidade em aplicações cloud. Desenvolver e manter aplicações .NET Core com integração em ambientes AWS. Criar e consumir REST APIs para integração entre sistemas. Implementar testes unitários para garantir qualidade e robustez do código. Trabalhar com Docker e Kubernetes para containerização e orquestração de serviços. Desenvolver e otimizar soluções utilizando AWS Lambda (Python), ECS Fargate, API Gateway, EventBridge, RDS MySQL, DynamoDB, Elastic Cache Redis, Secrets Manager, KMS, entre outros serviços AWS. Implementar soluções escaláveis e resilientes utilizando mensageria (Kafka). Aplicar conceitos de CI/CD utilizando CodeCommit, CodePipeline, CodeBuild. Seguir boas práticas de desenvolvimento orientadas a DevOps, Lean e Metodologias Ágeis.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Experiência com OmniStudio, aplicando aceleradores prontos para uso e personalizando-os para as necessidades da indústria de energia e serviços públicos;
  • Conhecimento em Business Rule Engine (BRE) para otimização de regras de negócios e processos de precificação complexos;

Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;

  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;

  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.


O que oferecemos:

Programas de incentivo à Certificações;

title: Java Software Engineer
description:
ENGLISH RESUMES ONLY


Join NFQ!

We are a global consultancy specialized in business, technology, and operations. We offer an integrated vision that covers the entire value chain of organizations. Our team includes over 2,000 professionals across national and international offices.

At NFQ, we offer a different consulting model: Flexible | Scalable | Specialized | Close to clients .


We are looking for a Java Software Engineer with strong technical expertise, deep understanding of backend architecture, and experience in the financial sector to join a dynamic, fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate is hands-on, collaborative, and capable of leading complex solution design while bridging the gap between technology and business goals.


What will you do?

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend solutions using Java and Spring Boot.
  • Ensure adherence to architectural frameworks, coding standards, and best practices in highly regulated financial environments.
  • Build and integrate microservices in a cloud or hybrid environment.
  • Contribute to the design of backend systems supporting banking processes such as trade settlement, reconciliations, FX, and cash management.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality technical solutions.
  • Implement robust strategies for monitoring, alerts, metrics, and testing (e.g., TDD, BDD).
  • Participate actively in Agile delivery processes and ensure technology solutions align with business outcomes.


What are we looking for?

Must Have:

  • 3+ years of backend development experience in Java (Spring Boot / Spring Cloud).
  • Hands-on experience with REST APIs and microservices architecture.
  • Knowledge of relational databases (SQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle) and messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar).
  • Solid grasp of distributed systems and SWIFT message standards (MX, MT).
  • Fluency in English .
  • Strong soft skills: communication, flexibility, accountability, teamwork, positive attitude, and mentorship abilities.


Nice to Have:

  • Experience in technical pre-sales or commercial engagements in banking projects.
  • Knowledge of financial products and markets: Derivatives, Fixed Income, FX, ETDs, and Energy.
  • Experience developing new treasury solutions.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools (Grafana, Prometheus, ELK).
  • Spanish language skills.


What do we offer?

  • The opportunity to work in an international environment with potential mobility across global offices.
  • Continuous learning and development, with access to official certifications.
  • Language classes to support your global career.
  • A tailored career development plan with mentorship and merit-based growth.

CLT contract model , including:

title: Facility Manager
description:
Americas Cluster Operations Team


We are the Americas Cluster Operations Team, a critical component of a leading global technology enterprise's infrastructure strategy. Our mission is to ensure the highly efficient, stable, and secure operation of the operational environment across the Americas. We are dedicated to delivering "last mile customer value" from our operational facilities, providing a seamless, reliable, and highly efficient service experience.


Our team comprises dedicated professionals in Facilities, IT, and Asset Management, deeply experienced in large-scale system operations, possessing comprehensive capabilities from daily operations to strategic planning:

Facilities Team: Responsible for 24x7 uninterrupted operations and emergency response of critical physical support systems within the large operational environment, including electrical, HVAC, and fire suppression. We ensure physical environment stability and sustainable operations through rigorous capacity management and energy efficiency optimization.

IT Team: Manages the full lifecycle operations of IT equipment like servers and networks within the operational environment. We ensure high SLA compliance for IT services through proactive systemic risk governance, automation, and process optimization, while leading various technology upgrade projects.

Asset Team: Oversees the full lifecycle management and governance of IT assets. We ensure asset compliance, visibility, and efficient utilization through precise data management, risk control, and cost-efficiency strategies.


Our Core Focuses:

End-to-End Reliability: From physical support to IT services, we provide comprehensive stability assurance, focused on mitigating risks and ensuring business continuity.

Project-Based & Lean Operations: We approach operational work through a project lens, continuously optimizing processes to achieve efficient resource utilization and lean operating costs.

Innovation & Talent Development: We actively integrate cutting-edge technologies and foster robust knowledge-sharing mechanisms to continuously enhance our team's professional capabilities and innovative practices.

We serve as the robust foundation for the enterprise's business growth in the Americas, providing powerful and trustworthy infrastructure assurance through professionalism, innovation, and collaboration.


Job Responsibilities:

1. Responsible for the daily operation and maintenance management of large-scale operational facilities within the responsible region, ensuring the efficient, stable, and compliant operation of their critical physical support systems (e.g., power, HVAC, fire suppression).

2. Develop and implement facility operation strategies, procedures, and emergency plans, ensuring facility operations comply with internal standards and external regulations.

3. Manage the facility operations team, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, and daily supervision, to enhance team professionalism and cohesion.

4. Lead facility capacity planning, energy efficiency management, and optimization projects, promoting sustainable operation practices and reducing operational costs.

5. Manage facility-related vendors and service providers, ensuring service quality and SLA compliance.

6. Lead or participate in root cause analysis for facility incidents, and the development and implementation of corrective actions.

7. Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams (e.g., IT, Security, Business Units) to ensure facility operations effectively support overall business objectives.


Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, HVAC, Automation, or a related engineering discipline.

2. Over 8 years of experience in large-scale facility operation and maintenance, with at least 3 years in a management role; experience in multinational corporations preferred.

3. Familiar with the operational principles, maintenance, and troubleshooting of critical physical support systems.

4. Proven team leadership and project management skills, capable of effectively driving complex project implementation.

5. Familiar with relevant safety regulations, industry standards, and environmental compliance.

6. Strong communication and coordination skills, problem-solving abilities, and risk management awareness.

7. Fluent in English, able to communicate effectively as a working language.

8. (Plus) Relevant professional certifications (e.g., PMP, CFM) are a plus.

9. (Plus) Familiarity with energy efficiency management and green operation practices is a plus.

description:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Your creativity and insights will truly matter in an environment that prioritizes your professional growth.

title: Product Owner
description:
ENGLISH RESUMES ONLY


JOB DESCRIPTION

The Product Owner (PO) for the Revenue Management System (RMS) is responsible for shaping and delivering integrated solutions that support pricing, demand forecasting, and revenue optimization. This role involves managing initiatives that span data engineering, machine learning, and user-facing interfaces. In addition to gathering and managing business requirements, the PO will be responsible for overseeing the full delivery lifecycle to ensure successful execution from concept through release.


DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Develop and maintain a backlog of features and enhancements spanning data pipelines, predictive models, and RMS user interfaces.

Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities to optimize pricing strategies and demand forecasting.

Gather, analyze, and document business requirements and translate them into detailed epics and user stories with clear descriptions, business rules, and acceptance criteria.

Own the full delivery lifecycle of features and enhancements, ensuring timely execution, alignment with stakeholders, and readiness for deployment.

Collaborate with Data Engineering on requirements for data sourcing, integration, and quality.

Partner with Data Science to define, deploy, and iterate on ML models and pricing algorithms.

Align with UI/UX and front-end teams to ensure a seamless user experience.

Facilitate cross-functional workshops and planning sessions with business stakeholders.

Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess product success and user adoption.

Ensure accurate documentation in Confluence and Jira for themes, epics, and tasks.

Coordinate with QA to validate features and ensure delivery meets requirements.

Promote continuous iteration based on stakeholder feedback and performance data.

Drive change management and support user training for new RMS features.

Ensure compliance with data governance, security, and regulatory standards.

Identify and mitigate risks associated with process and system changes.

Actively participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.

Perform other job-related functions as assigned.


QUALIFICATIONS

DEGREE TYPE:

Bachelor's Degree


FIELD(S) OF STUDY:

Business Management, Data Analytics, or related fields


EXPERIENCE;

  • At least 3 years of experience in end-to-end product ownership, product management, or delivery of data or optimization platforms.
  • Experience working across Data Engineering, Data Science, and UI Development teams, as well with multiple stakeholders and brand Revenue Management teams.
  • Experience working in Agile software development environments with cross-functional teams.
  • Industry experience in cruise, travel, or enterprise data systems is a plus.


COMPETENCIES/SKILLS

  • Exposure to revenue management, pricing systems, or forecasting tools is preferred
  • Strong understanding of Agile delivery methodologies and iterative development
  • Familiarity with data pipelines, ML model lifecycle, and modern UI patterns
  • Ability to define and refine user stories across technical and business domains
  • Proficient in Jira, Confluence, and backlog management tools
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Excellent facilitation, documentation, and analytical skills
  • Understanding of change management principles and user adoption strategies
  • High attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities
  • Strong business acumen and problem-solving capabilities
  • Adaptability in fast-paced, cross-functional environments


CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSES

Add certifications/licenses (if any) here.

  • Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar Agile certification preferred
  • Product Management or Lean Six Sigma certification is a plus

title: IT Operations Manager
description:
We are the Americas Cluster Operations Team, a critical component of a leading global technology enterprise's infrastructure strategy. Our mission is to ensure the highly efficient, stable, and secure operation of the operational environment across the Americas. Our team comprises dedicated professionals in Facilities, IT, and Asset Management, deeply experienced in large-scale system operations, possessing comprehensive capabilities from daily operations to strategic planning:Facilities Team: Responsible for 24x7 uninterrupted operations and emergency response of critical physical support systems within the large operational environment, including electrical, HVAC, and fire suppression. We ensure physical environment stability and sustainable operations through rigorous capacity management and energy efficiency optimization.IT Team: Manages the full lifecycle operations of IT equipment like servers and networks within the operational environment. We ensure high SLA compliance for IT services through proactive systemic risk governance, automation, and process optimization, while leading various technology upgrade projects.Asset Team: Oversees the full lifecycle management and governance of IT assets. We ensure asset compliance, visibility, and efficient utilization through precise data management, risk control, and cost-efficiency strategies.Our Core Focuses:End-to-End Reliability: From physical support to IT services, we provide comprehensive stability assurance, focused on mitigating risks and ensuring business continuity.Project-Based & Lean Operations: We approach operational work through a project lens, continuously optimizing processes to achieve efficient resource utilization and lean operating costs.Innovation & Talent Development: We actively integrate cutting-edge technologies and foster robust knowledge-sharing mechanisms to continuously enhance our team's professional capabilities and innovative practices.We serve as the robust foundation for the enterprise's business growth in the Americas, providing powerful and trustworthy infrastructure assurance through professionalism, innovation, and collaboration.


Job Responsibilities:

1. Responsible for the comprehensive operation and maintenance management of IT infrastructure (including but not limited to servers, networks, storage, and related software platforms) within large-scale operational environments in the Americas region.

2. Develop and implement IT operation strategies, procedures, and standards (SOPs) to ensure the efficient, stable, and secure operation of IT systems, in compliance with internal and external regulations.

3. Manage the IT operations team, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, team development, and daily management, to enhance team professionalism and efficiency.

4. Lead IT incident management, event response, change management, and problem-solving processes to ensure high availability and business continuity of IT systems.

5. Drive the IT operations' transformation towards automation and intelligence, introducing advanced technologies and tools to continuously optimize operational processes, efficiency, and quality.

6. Responsible for IT infrastructure capacity planning, performance monitoring, and optimization to ensure resource allocation meets business growth demands.

7. Manage IT-related vendors and third-party service providers, ensuring their service quality and SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance.

8. Responsible for IT operations budget planning, cost control, and analysis of technology investment returns.

9. Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams (e.g., Facilities, Asset Management, Security, Business Units) to ensure IT operations effectively support overall business objectives.

10. Stay abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies, supporting the evolution of IT architecture to enhance technological competitiveness.



Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Network Engineering, Electronic Information Engineering, or a related IT professional field.

2. Over 5 years of experience in large-scale IT system operation and maintenance management, with at least 3 years in a team management role; experience in multinational corporations is a plus.

3. In-depth understanding and practical experience with server hardware, operating systems (Linux/Windows), network technologies (TCP/IP, routing & switching), and storage systems.

4. Familiar with ITIL/ITSM management frameworks, possessing excellent capabilities in ITIL process implementation and optimization.

5. Practical experience with IT automation and intelligent operation tools (e.g., scripting languages, monitoring systems, configuration management tools).

6. Excellent team leadership, project management, and risk management capabilities.

7. Outstanding communication, coordination, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, capable of handling complex technical and managerial issues.

8. Strong English reading, writing, and communication skills, able to communicate effectively as a working language.

9. (Plus) Relevant professional certifications such as ITIL, PMP, CCIE/CCNP, RHCE are a plus.

10. (Plus) Experience in cloud platform operations or DevOps practices is a plus.

The Hunter Douglas Global Management Trainee Program (GMT) is hand-selected and sponsored by the Executive Leadership Team. This 10-month comprehensive Leadership Development program provides you with the tools and experiences to develop you into a future leader of our organization while providing a holistic view of the business. Throughout this program, you will immediately immerse yourself into the company, the culture, and the industry. You will join a class of other Trainees and gain a community of ambitious peers. You will learn from Hunter Douglas leaders and contribute directly to our purpose and our DREAM. You will gain insights from day one and do real work on different projects while delivering actual results.

Before the program commences, Trainees are paired with a Mentor to help acclimate and integrate you to our organization. Throughout the program, you can expect opportunities to connect and collaborate with our Executive Leadership Team, Global Leaders, Business Leaders, previous Trainees and current Trainees from other Zones.

What you'll do

  • Three weeks of onboarding - one week of local onboarding at your designated hub location and zone. 
    • Global Induction at our HQ - providing an introduction to our company's strategy, culture, products, sales channels and problem-solving approaches.
  • Five months of Field Training in which you will rotate through key areas of our value chain including Sales, Supply, Logistics, Product, Customer Service, and will gain hands-on experience by actively participating in daily operations and project work during each rotation.
  • One week of Leadership and Methodology training to foster a unified system-thinking approach and prepare you for your first project.
  • A four-month individual project in which you will be able to deliver tangible and measurable results as an active team member by applying methodology skills and technical knowledge.
  • Capstone presentation of your project to Leadership, followed by feedback and final placement into a full-time role upon program completion - designed to support your continued leadership development and long-term career growth with Hunter Douglas.
  • First Position Placement can be in any of the following areas: Sales, Operations (Supply, Logistics, Procurement), Product, or Functional. 

Below are examples of projects that previous Trainees' have worked on

  • Create a new implementation process for when Hunter Douglas introduces a new product.
  • Implement recommendations to optimize material usage and mitigate scrap rates at our plants.
  • Pricing Analysis for our e-commerce platforms.
  • Develop a communication strategy to enhance our customer installation journey.
  • Monetize our Market Funnel valuation by quantifying our conversion rates.

Qualifications:

  • To qualify, candidates must have an expected graduation date of December 2025
  • Have demonstrated leadership capabilities through various extracurricular activities including job experiences, internships, student clubs and organizations, and volunteer work.
  • Must be fully mobile and willing to be on-site at one of our major locations throughout the program. Be ready to tackle new challenges in diverse environments, including front line roles in the field, manufacturing plants, regional offices, among others. 

Who you are 

  • Hard-working and enjoys a high level of responsibility.
  • Hungry for success, yet humble to continuously learn.
  • You think like an owner and take accountability for your actions.
  • Problem-Solver who leads with agility and acts with a sense of urgency.
  • Intellectually curious and willing to challenge the status quo.
  • A natural leader who enjoys collaborating with teams to complete ambitious but achievable big goals.
  • Strong interest in a multi-functional career with a readiness to work hard to become a future leader in our global company.
  • Trainees are expected to live our values, our culture, and be ambassadors of the program and future leaders of the organization.

What's in it for you

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Generous benefits package 
  • Paid Time Off 
  • Career developmental opportunities
  • A company culture that prioritizes internal development

title: Account Executive - Marketing Solutions
description:
São Paulo/SP - Brazil


SiiLA is the dominant authority in commercial real estate news, data, and analysis across Latin America. Since our founding in 2015, we have built a reputation for delivering precise , reliable market intelligence with a relentless commitment to quality and integrity .


Powered by cutting-edge technology, SiiLA transforms raw data into actionable insights through subscription-based solutions trusted by the world’s top commercial real estate professionals. Our platform offers unparalleled transparency , empowering clients to make informed decisions in a rapidly evolving industry.


Visit our website: siila.com.br


About the Role:

Are you passionate about commercial real estate, technology, and helping others succeed? SiiLA is looking for an Account Executive who combines business acumen with a consultative approach to selling.

This is not just a sales role—it’s an opportunity to join a dynamic, fast-growing organization where your efforts will directly influence our continued success. We’re looking for someone who is eager to become an expert in our products, understands the nuances of the commercial real estate industry, and embraces the challenge of developing long-term client relationships.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop a deep understanding of SiiLA’s products, data, and the commercial real estate market to build credibility and be a trusted advisor to clients.
  • Understand the Platform's Advertising Features: Gain a deep knowledge of the platform’s advertising offerings, tools, and capabilities to effectively showcase the benefits to potential clients and maximize their value.
  • Strategize Advertising Solutions: Work closely with the marketing team to design customized advertising solutions for clients, utilizing platform features to target the right audience and enhance commercial real estate market visibility.
  • Client Consultation & Advisory: Serve as a trusted advisor by understanding clients’ needs and leveraging the platform’s advertising tools to achieve their business objectives, particularly in the commercial real estate sector.
  • Actively identify and qualify new business opportunities, leveraging a consultative selling approach to tailor solutions to client needs.
  • Engage with prospects through persistent outreach, effective listening, and thoughtful presentations to communicate SiiLA’s value proposition.
  • Performance Analysis & Reporting: Continuously monitor the performance of advertising campaigns on the platform, providing clients with insights and recommendations to optimize their campaigns.
  • Educate Clients on the Platform’s Value: Conduct presentations, training sessions, and workshops to educate clients on effectively using the platform’s advertising features, fostering long-term client relationships and engagement.
  • Collaborate with Product Development: Provide feedback to the product development team regarding client needs and industry trends, helping to refine and enhance the platform’s advertising benefits for greater market relevance.
  • Drive Client Acquisition & Retention: Proactively identify opportunities to acquire new clients and retain existing ones by showcasing the unique advantages and results that the platform’s advertising solutions deliver within the commercial real estate market.
  • Stay Current with Industry Trends: Keep updated with digital advertising and commercial real estate trends to ensure the platform remains competitive and aligned with market demands.
  • Take initiative to experiment, refine processes, and share ideas to help SiiLA scale in the Brazil Market and beyond.
  • Build strong relationships with prospects, clients, and industry stakeholders, maintaining trust and delivering value .
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth onboarding and exceptional client experiences .

What Makes You a Great Fit:

·      Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field.

·      A minimum of three years of experience in Marketing sales, preferably within commercial real estate, technology, or a related industry.

·      Strong business sense with the ability to qualify prospects effectively and identify opportunities for tailored solutions in Marketing.

·      A natural curiosity and willingness to dive into data, technology, and market trends to build expertise and credibility.

·      Entrepreneurial mindset with a drive to contribute to the growth of a fast-evolving organization and make a measurable impact.

·      Excellent interpersonal skills and clear, effective communication in both English and Portuguese.

·      Persistence and resilience in handling objections, with the ability to bounce back and stay motivated .

·      Strong organizational skills to manage multiple priorities, stay on top of leads, and deliver results .

·      Confidence and presence to engage with executives while remaining personable and approachable.

·      Coachable and adaptable , with a continuous improvement mindset and the ability to apply feedback effectively.

title: Assistente de vendas
description:
Tarefas Auxiliar de Vendas

As tarefas de um auxiliar de vendas geralmente envolvem apoiar a equipe comercial e garantir que o processo de vendas seja mais ágil e organizado. Aqui estão as principais responsabilidades:

  • Atualizar planilhas e sistemas de CRM (cadastro de clientes, propostas, follow-ups).
  • Organizar documentos de vendas, contratos e orçamentos.
  • Preparar relatórios de desempenho (metas, resultados, pipeline).
  • Acompanhar envios considerando fretes e coleta por parte da transportadora.

 Apoio Comercial

  • Auxiliar na elaboração de propostas comerciais.
  • Realizar cotações com fornecedores e validação de estoques.
  • Dar suporte ao time de vendas em apresentações ou reuniões.
  • Acompanhar status de negociações e prazos de entrega.

Atendimento ao Cliente

  • Atender clientes por telefone, e-mail ou WhatsApp.
  • Esclarecer dúvidas sobre produtos, preços e prazos.
  • Encaminhar contatos para os vendedores responsáveis.
  • Fazer follow-up (acompanhamento) de propostas enviadas.

Organização e Logística

  • Controlar estoque de materiais de apoio (catálogos, brindes, amostras).
  • Acompanhar logística de entregas em conjunto com o setor responsável.
  • Garantir que os vendedores tenham materiais atualizados (catálogos, tabelas de preço).
  • Apoiar na organização do material que foi vendido.

    • Em resumo, o auxiliar de vendas não atua diretamente na negociação final, mas garante que os vendedores tenham informações, suporte e organização para focar nas vendas.

title: Senior Lean Management-Warehouse Layout
description:
Location: GLP Guarulhos II - R. Concretex, 800 - Cumbica, Guarulhos - SP,


ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!


ABOUT THE ROLE

Key Responsibilities

1.Warehouse Layout Planning: Design warehouse layouts for new facilities and redesign existing layouts for renovation projects. Optimize picking, packing and shipping areas to reduce travel time, improve ergonomics and maximize space utilization.

2.Material Flow Optimization: Analyze inbound, put-away, picking and outbound processes; optimize material flow and work areas to increase efficiency.

3.Time Studies: Conduct detailed time studies and work sampling to establish and maintain standard operating times.

4.Capacity & ROI Analysis: Develop cost–benefit and ROI models for layout changes, automation investments and process improvements.

5.New Project Support: Provide IE support for new warehouse start-ups, process changes and layout integrations.

6.Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with operations, safety, IT and automation teams to ensure smooth implementation of changes.


Requirements

1.Bachelor’s degree or above in Industrial Engineering, Logistics Engineering, Operations Management or related fields.

2.5+ years of experience in warehouse IE, layout design or process improvement.

3.Familiarity with IE tools such as time studies, motion studies and capacity balancing.

4.Proficient in AutoCAD/Visio for layout design and Excel/Power BI for data analysis and reporting.

5.Strong numerical analysis and ROI modeling skills.

6.Excellent cross-department communication and coordination skills.

7.Good command of spoken and written English.


CAREERS AT SHEIN


We Commit to Inclusion

At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.


We Empower Talents with Diverse Careers

At SHEIN, we empower talent to excel with regular opportunities to elevate their career in their respective fields. As a dynamic business, we support internal mobility, diverse career pathways and recognition of success and contribution in a variety of meaningful ways.


We Engage with Global Cultures

SHEIN has over 20 offices worldwide , providing talent with many opportunities to collaborate with colleagues around the world. Perspective sharing and leveraging cultural differences, is one of our core strenghts as we work on many exciting projects and draw insights from industry-leading experience.

The ideal candidate must possess extensive mining industry networks, a hunter mentality for new business acquisition, and proven experience managing key accounts in demanding environments.

Strategic Business Development

  • Develop and execute growth strategies to achieve annual sales targets and market penetration goals.

Key Account Management

  • Conduct quarterly business reviews to ensure client satisfaction and identify upsell opportunities.

Market Intelligence & Expansion

RESUMO DO CARGO

  10. Negociar condições comerciais com fornecedores de acordo com as estratégias de sourcing.

  14. Realizar visitas técnicas a unidades da empresa e fornecedores.

Pré-requisitos

1) Pacote Office Excel intermediário/avançado

2) Sistema ERP: SAP Modulo MM

3) Técnicas de Negociação


Sobre a Ardagh

A Ardagh Metal Packaging (AMP) é uma das líderes globais na produção e venda de embalagens de alumínio para bebidas, com 3 unidades de produção no Brasil - fábricas de latas em Jacareí (SP) e Alagoinhas (BA) e uma fábrica de tampas de Manaus (AM) – e um escritório localizado em São Paulo. title: Economist, Latin America
description:
Summary of Primary Role


The Economist will play a vital role in supporting our sales pipelines, driving client engagement, and producing data-driven insights that impact on our target markets.


Key Responsibilities


  • Support sales pipelines through data-driven insight production and client meetings in Latin America, both in the Colombia and Brazil offices.
  • Attend client meetings alongside our sales teams for strategic opportunities.
  • Produce regular data-driven economic insights and dashboards aligned with CEIC’s go-to-market plan target addressable markets.
  • Support global insight production through team collaboration and global editorial calendar with thematic cross-region and global economic insights.
  • Support the delivery of the regional community engagement plan.
  • Contribute to marketing activities related to the development of the company’s brand awareness and thought leadership in Latin America countries through preparation of content and participation marketing and public speaking initiatives.


To be considered for this role you will need to have:


  • A degree in Economics or Finance.
  • Prior experience with macroeconomic, industry and financial data, with a focus on Latin America.
  • Excellent analytical capabilities working with large data sets with rigorous attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills in front of a large audience.
  • Experience writing research publications.
  • Ability to work well in a team, showing excellent team spirit; strong organizational skills are essential.
  • Experience in programming languages applied to economics (R, Python, etc)
  • Fluency in English. Experience writing English-language analytical publications.
  • Spanish speaking is a plus.
  • Positive attitude and a “can do” approach.


What We Offer:

  • Full time employment contract
  • Open and friendly working atmosphere
  • Excellent remuneration package
  • Flexible working culture and hybrid working model


How to Apply:

If you are looking for interesting and challenging job, please, do not hesitate to apply and send your CV in English.

All job applicants will be treated with strict confidentiality. Only short-listed candidates will be contacted.


About ISI Markets:


ISI Markets is the most comprehensive source of trusted data and actionable insight on emerging and developed markets. We provide the intelligence and insights to act with confidence in the world’s highest potential and fastest growing markets. ISI Markets is comprised of four brands (CEIC, EPFR, EMIS and REDD) that share a common purpose to illuminate the opportunity in emerging and developed markets where information can be hard to obtain and even harder to rely upon. We leverage deep local knowledge, well established networks and leading-edge software and advanced analytics to deliver intelligence that informs our clients’ investment, strategic and risk decisions.

Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

  • Atuar na gestão de um time de executivos de grandes contas (300k a 2M de TPV mensal) na estrutura de Big Sellers para os produtos de Instore (QR e Point). Renovar estratégias de retenção de clientes da carteira assessorada (acompanhamento de movimentos de players do mercado, entender necessidades dos sellers, melhoria frequente de metodologias e processos).

Gestão de upsell e cross-sell da carteira com acompanhamento de pipeline com executivos e monitoria de novas oportunidades dentro da carteira assessorada + estratégia de tombamento na carteira para novos produtos. Dar visibilidade e estruturar priorização de melhorias e desenvolvimento de produtos.

Acompanhar e definir estratégias para aumentar a escalabilidade das atuações com sellers e melhorar a produtividade do time.

Requisitos:

Nós lhe propomos:

  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)

Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de software.

Desejável:

  • Conhecimento em observabilidade e monitoramento (Sentry, Firebase Performance, Crashlytics).
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento nativo (Kotlin/Swift) e comunicação via Platform Channels.
  • Publicação e manutenção de aplicativos nas lojas oficiais.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias Ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).

Modelo de Contratação: PJ

Valorizamos perspectivas diversas e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com diferentes experiências. Se você é uma pessoa Tech Lead Flutter e está buscando uma oportunidade desafiadora em uma empresa inovadora, se candidate na posição.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Atuação híbrida; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados para integrar nosso time responsável pela evolução de uma plataforma Data Lakehouse na AWS . Essa pessoa terá papel fundamental na integração de dados de múltiplas fontes, na orquestração de pipelines confiáveis e na disponibilização de camadas analíticas performáticas para consumo via Amazon Redshift e Power BI .


Modelo de atuação: Híbrido (2 a 3 vezes por semana)

Localidade: Brasília

  • Projetar e implementar pipelines de dados utilizando Airflow/MWAA , com Python e SQL , seguindo boas práticas de modularidade, testes e versionamento.
  • Modelar camadas Bronze/Silver/Gold (arquitetura Medallion) em S3 + Glue Data Catalog , definindo partições, formatos (Parquet/Delta*) e tabelas otimizadas para consulta.
  • Construir e otimizar modelos analíticos em Amazon Redshift , garantindo performance e custo.
  • Publicar e manter datasets confiáveis para Power BI , incluindo gateways, incremental refresh, agregações e uso eficiente de DirectQuery/Import.
  • Colaborar com analistas e times de negócio, traduzindo necessidades em datasets, KPIs e camadas consumíveis, além de documentar catálogos e contratos de dados.


Requisitos e qualificações


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência sólida em AWS : S3, Glue Data Catalog, Airflow (preferencialmente MWAA), DAGs em Python, Amazon Redshift.
  • Linguagens: Python e SQL avançado .
  • Power BI : modelagem semântica, DAX, incremental refresh, gateway, boas práticas para consumo de Redshift.
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura Data Lakehouse , formatos colunares (Parquet), partições e metadados.
  • Boas práticas de engenharia: Git, testes, code reviews, documentação, pipelines confiáveis.
  • Segurança e governança: IAM, criptografia, princípios de mínimo privilégio, LGPD aplicada a dados.

description:
Lead Data Platform Architect


Mars is a family-owned business with more than $50 billion in global sales. We produce some of the world’s best-loved brands: M&M’s®, SNICKERS®, TWIX®, MILKY WAY®, DOVE®, PEDIGREE®, ROYAL CANIN®, WHISKAS®, EXTRA®, ORBIT®, 5™, SKITTLES®, BEN’S ORIGINAL®, and COCOAVIA®. Alongside our consumer brands, we proudly take care of half of the world’s pets through our nutrition, health and services businesses such as Banfield Pet Hospitals™, BluePearl®, Linnaeus, AniCura, VCA™ and Pet Partners™. Headquartered in McLean, VA, Mars operates in more than 80 countries. The Mars Five Principles – Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency and Freedom – inspire our 160,000 Diverse Associates to act daily towards creating the world we want tomorrow.


The Lead Data Platform Architect is instrumental in delivering scalable, repeatable and agile data and platform architectures to unlock and drive business value across Finance, Commercial, R&D, MGS Labs and Innovation:


As the Lead Data Platform Architect in the Enterprise Data & Platform team, your key responsibilities are as follows:


TECHNICAL PROFICIENCY AND LEADERSHIP

  • Lead the definition and execution of data architecture strategies across multiple business domains and data platforms.
  • Drive the development of scalable, integrated data models and architectures across raw, trusted, and harmonized zones.
  • Define and execute the data product strategy for assigned business areas in collaboration with analytics and business teams.
  • Act as a thought leader and trusted advisor, supporting teams in understanding business objectives, data requirements, processes, and enabling technologies.
  • Ensure all data architecture efforts are aligned with the broader business vision and strategic priorities and provide architectural oversight across delivery initiatives.
  • Collaborate with other data architects to ensure consistent and integrated use of data assets across the organization.
  • Identify cross-segment and cross-function data dependencies or issues and lead resolution efforts.
  • Provide strategic guidance on data domains, process analysis, data analysis, and modelling techniques.
  • Mentor and coach solution / data architects and engineers to build internal data architecture capability.
  • Advocate for best practices, tools, and methods related to data architecture.
  • Ensure understanding and compliance of data protection policies, security policies, and GDPR


DELIVERABLE INVOLVEMENT & OWNERSHIP

  • Reference Architectures: Own and maintain reusable architectural patterns
  • High-Level Designs (HLDs): Review and approve HLDs from Solution Architects and 3rd parties
  • Key Design Decisions (KDDs): Own and govern major architectural decisions for alignment with the Architecture Review Board and beyond
  • Architecture Option Assessments: Lead decisioning on tooling, modelling, and patterns


DATA & PLATFORM ARCHITECTURE OWNERSHIP

  • Develop and maintain current and future state data architectures, models, and roadmaps.
  • Promote awareness and understanding of data architectures across the organization.
  • Review and validate high-level models and reference architecture libraries
  • Approve changes to shared or enterprise-wide data models


Knowledge and Experience


ESSENTIAL:

  • Previous experience as a Senior Data or Platform Architect essential
  • Proven experience as a senior data or platform architect, or similar leadership role in data & platform strategy.
  • Strong background in data modelling, architecture frameworks, and modern data integration methods.
  • Deep understanding of cloud-based data platforms (Azure) and tools (Databricks, SQL, ADF etc) as well as analytics solutions.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence and align across business and technology functions.
  • Experience building and evolving data & platform architectures that scale and adapt to changing business needs.
  • Passion for coaching and enabling others with a collaborative leadership approach.
  • Knowledgeable in Data Source systems (eg. SAP) and Data Lake technology
  • Stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Fluent in writing and speaking English


DESIRED:

  • Previous experience in CPG industry would be ideal
  • Experience at operating in a complex global matrix organisation
  • Experience at collaborating with cross-functional partners
  • High drive for results and an ability to work with minimum input


What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
  • Join a purpose-driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
  • Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
  • An industry-competitive salary and benefits package, including a company bonus.
